source_text: Anatomically, FGM often involves clitoridectomy or infibulation, severing the clitoris—which contains over 8,000 nerve endings analogous to penile tissue but concentrated for primary sexual pleasure—resulting in permanent loss of sensation, chronic pain, and dyspareunia. [18]
